scope: All pages visually screened for benchmark families.
finding: Sections 4 and 5 test static, oscillating, rotating and magnetic stellar polytropes. These require self-gravity or magnetic physics and are distinct from the current constant-pressure density-square and wall-supported hydrostatic cases.

scope: All pages visually screened; application discussion at physical PDF pages 22 to 27.
finding: Review discussion at 11.1 covers linear waves, step/cylinder supersonic flow, Sod, Noh and Rayleigh-Taylor, largely pointing to prior or unpublished work. Section 11.12 discusses nearly incompressible dam/bore flows. These are discovery/discussion relationships, not newly supplied exact benchmark specifications.

scope: All pages visually screened; benchmark sections and tables inspected.
finding: Section 6 gives an unforced elliptical drop with analytic ODE comparison, section 7 compares collapsing-dam kinematics to Martin and Moyce, and section 9 demonstrates wave generation. The drop is distinct from central-force oscillation.
